description.p: Azzurro is a controller for BluOS players — Bluesound, NAD and PSB. It finds the players on your network, shows what each one is doing, and drives them: transport, volume, the play queue, and browsing every source the player offers.

Browsing is not built from a list of music services. Each player describes its own screens, and Azzurro renders what it is given, so a service added to BluOS after this was written browses and plays without an update here.

ul.li: Finds players by broadcast, and remembers ones that discovery cannot reach
Now playing with cover art, seeking, shuffle, repeat and a sleep timer
The play queue, with a context menu on every track
Browse and search every source the player offers, including music services
Group players together for multi-room playback
Each player appears separately in the desktop's own media controls, so the media keys work

description.p: Written in Rust throughout, with Slint for the interface. No webview, no Electron, and no accounts.
